session_summary: A patient discussed symptoms of high blood pressure, including headaches, dizziness, and palpitations. The doctor prescribed medication, advised lifestyle changes, and scheduled follow-up tests and appointments.

proposed_actions.title: Measure Blood Pressure
proposed_actions.description: Measure blood pressure twice daily and record results in a notebook
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I want you to measure your blood pressure at home twice a day, in the morning and evening

proposed_actions.title: Take Medication
proposed_actions.description: Take amlodipine 5 milligrams once daily in the morning
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: I'll prescribe you amlodipine 5 milligrams, one tablet in the morning

proposed_actions.title: Get Blood Tests
proposed_actions.description: Complete blood tests: cholesterol, blood sugar, creatinine, and ionogram
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Please do them by Wednesday, on the spot

proposed_actions.title: Schedule Electrocardiogram
proposed_actions.description: Undergo an electrocardiogram at the assistant's station
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: we'll do it right here, at the assistant, after the consultation

proposed_actions.title: Attend Follow-Up Appointment
proposed_actions.description: Attend a follow-up appointment on Friday, November 13th, at 10 o'clock
proposed_actions.transcript_excerpt: Come back on Friday, November 13th, at 10 o'clock

decisions: Prescribe amlodipine 5 milligrams once daily in the morning
Schedule blood tests and an electrocardiogram
Recommend reducing coffee intake and limiting salt consumption
risks: If blood pressure exceeds 180 or symptoms like numbness, blurred vision, or chest pain occur, call 112 immediately
follow_up_questions: Is there a specific time frame for the follow-up appointment?
Are there any additional lifestyle changes recommended?
